anchors.name: a1-descent
anchors.note: The establishing frame, looking back at the way in. Tests the shaft as the only "up", the rubble spill, and whether the hand-cut vault reads under a single cold source plus headlamp.

anchors.name: a2-shaft
anchors.note: Straight up into the break-in. Tests the broken floor slab, snapped joists, rim stones and the lit dust — the one moment the room admits there is a building above it.

anchors.name: a3-names
anchors.note: THE scene. Reading distance (0.9 m) on the east wall under headlamp. Tests inscription legibility, the carve normal, and block-face relief. If the names cannot be read here, nothing else matters.

anchors.name: a4-niche
anchors.note: The mouth of a punishment niche: iron staple, tally marks, low arched head. Tests tight-space headlamp falloff and that the niche reads as a place a person was put.

anchors.name: a5-seal
anchors.note: The brick seal at the far end over standing water. Tests brick-vs-limestone material contrast, the water clear coat, and the payload: someone did this deliberately.
